title: Smile‘s Space mod
description: Explore the universe using blocks created with Create
body:
A mod made for a modpack by the author.
If you download this mod alone, you can only explore.
Add a new dimension "Universe".
Currently, all features have not been fully implemented.
In future versions, there will be ways to access extra dimensions.
But until then, you can only enter through commands.
Don't say I didn't warn you if you go in without a helmet.
Future versions will include more content related to space exploration.
Including spacecraft, galaxies, and so on.
If you want to help us improve the mod, please email us. wyj121023@163.com
create use mcretor
